canonical_thesis: Independent Web3-native AI governance builder economy. Community first, crypto native, evidence reviewed, referrals, quests, retention, governance.
supersedes: All Witness-specific pre-Web3 preservation, institutional distribution, corporate consultancy and Stripe checkout instructions
outbound_mail: disabled by default. A connected mailbox is not authority to speak for Witness.
revenue_and_economy: Community native economics, optional funded missions and verified crypto payments when actually supported and authorized; no fabricated cash or token.
live_status_rule: Pilot blueprint is not an officially founder-published community; member and XP records require real authenticated users.
production_rule: Deploy only allowlisted Web3 pages; reject any institutional services, corporate checkout, or outbound mail links.
rights: No implied venture equity, company IP rights, or profit share.
owner_signature_authority: Must be Witness-specific and explicitly authorized for any outbound communication. Never reuse another venture's account solely because it is connected.
future_agents: Never reinstate the legacy model without a new explicit founder directive.
